records.cite: doc 01 Quirks (opt-in group option; every player starts the season with one random quirk; each player sees their own; others learn by watching; D-052 real disorder names); doc 02 section 22.2

doc 01 Quirks: Shaken lasts twice as long, sprint refills faster. Bases: taint.json shaken.duration_s 60, labor.json sprint.refill_s 10. Refill x0.5 is a placeholder (sprint max_s stays 6, so a sprint is not longer, only available again sooner)
records.name: Anxiety disorder

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: their lantern lights half as far. Base: lantern 9 m (doc 07 s4.4), Brighter lantern x1.5; the two multiply (4.5 m, 6.75 m). The creature still spots the lantern at creature.json sight_light_m (a handicap never hides the player)
records.name: Nyctophobia

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: their voice carries 50% further, so lures favour them. Base: creature.json noise_voice radius_m 60, so 90 m at a full byte. No extra lure weight: the lure picker already favours whoever is loudest (doc 03 12.1)
records.name: ADHD

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: now and then they alone hear a footstep behind them that isn't there. Numbers placeholder. The sound is local to that player: it is never emitted to the creature, never a ghost voice, never the flicker or a radio, and moves no tension
records.name: Paranoia

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: private hallucinations start on day 1 instead of day 5. Base: ai_director.json scare_hallucination opens_day 5. Same scare, same weight and big-scare budget for that player (scare_rules.big_per_player_per_day 1): it only opens early for them
records.name: Schizophrenia

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: a jumpscare drops everything they carry, not just the held item. Base: ai_director.json scare_jumpscare drops the held item; labor.json carry capacity 4
records.name: Dyspraxia

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: one extra carry slot, 10% slower walk. Bases: labor.json carry 4, walk 3.0 m/s, crouch 1.2 m/s. Walk and crouch slow; sprint (5.0 m/s) does not, so a chase is no harder. Sim: plot capacity falls 2.9% (tools/sim, doc 02 section 22.3)
records.name: Hoarding disorder

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: last to get a body at dawn, a few seconds after everyone else. 6 s is a placeholder for 'a few'. They still count for headcount at that dawn (doc 02 section 4: a body at dawn). Dawn is daylight, so the wait is never dangerous
records.name: Narcolepsy

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: bear traps take a little longer to snap on them. Base: traps.json bear_trap snaps at once. 0.6 s lets them step off; the click still sounds at the step (creature hears it as before), so the dodge saves the leg and never the noise
records.name: Grandiose delusions

records.cite: doc 01 Quirks: walking under the scarecrow's gaze makes them Shaken. Numbers placeholder. Shaken is the taint.json record (60 s, restarts on a new cause), never Taint. A scarecrow's gaze is its front arc
records.name: OCD
